mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_LeastPrivilege removes the constraint that a successful operation's caller must hold a role with permission for the endpoint. The injection forces a successful GetAudit by a caller with only the Applicant role, which the LeastPrivilege assertion is designed to forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some o: Operation, u: User | o.caller = u and o.outcome = OK and o.kind = GetAudit and u.roles = Applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the uniqueness-per-transition constraint. The injection introduces two distinct AuditEntries describing the same (app, prev, new) slot — exactly the duplication that append-only forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.app = ae2.app and ae1.prevStatus = ae2.prevStatus and ae1.newStatus = ae2.newStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_NoSelfAssignment lets a LoanApplication be assigned to its own applicant — the precise FR-011 violation NoSelfMutation must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoSelfAssignmentViolation { some a: LoanApplication | some a.assignedOfficer and a.assignedOfficer = a.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditCompletenessOnSuccess decouples successful state-changing operations from their audit entries. The injection produces a successful PATCH with no audit entry, which violates the audit-completeness invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some o: Operation | o.outcome = OK and o.kind = PatchStatus and no o.audit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ByteEquivalentNotFound removes the constraint that denied/not-found reads collapse to NotFoundBody. The injection forces a denied GetApplicationById response that is not byte-equivalent to the canonical not-found shape, leaking existence information.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoInformationLeakageViolation { some o: Operation | o.kind = GetApplicationById and o.outcome = PermDenied and o.response != NotFoundBody }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_PatchOnlyAssignedOfficer removes the requirement that the PATCH caller equal the application's assigned officer. The injection forces a successful PATCH by a non-assigned officer — exactly what FR-012 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipBasedAccessViolation { some o: Operation | o.outcome = OK and o.kind = PatchStatus and some o.target and o.caller != o.target.assignedOfficer }
